subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should reply-session initialization conflicts recover in shared session lifecycle, in individual channel transports, or in both layers with explicitly distinct responsibilities?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 implement recovery for the same conflict at different ownership boundaries; merging both without a contract could multiply delays and lifecycle actions.

options.title: Shared lifecycle recovery
options.body: Use the fenced shared self-heal as canonical and retain channel behavior only for a distinct terminal user-visible delivery fallback.

options.title: Discord transport retry
options.body: Use this channel-specific mitigation and defer the broader shared-session recovery.

options.title: Layered recovery
options.body: Keep both only after defining combined retry budgets, abort semantics, and terminal failure behavior with focused tests.

recommendation.title: Shared lifecycle recovery
recommendation.body: Use the fenced shared self-heal as canonical and retain channel behavior only for a distinct terminal user-visible delivery fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history connects this person to both the Discord dispatch surface and shared session lifecycle where the ownership choice belongs.
